authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12487 śītala explicitly lists Gawri šalá cold, Hindi sīlā cool and Torwali/Palula šidul/šidālo with unexplained d. Its addendum qualifies l/lh forms as *śītalla or crossed with *śaitalya. The containing article is used with those phonological qualifications retained, not as a claim of regular unmodified inheritance. Exact survey form śidālo is preserved.
